messages_read.title: Read messages
messages_read.description: Receives the messages Meshloom hears, as allowed below and by the conversations you pick for this plugin.
messages_read.channels_public: Public channels only: the Public channel and the # channels anyone can join.
messages_read.outgoing: The messages you send, including the ones this plugin sends.

messages_send.title: Send messages
messages_send.description: Sends messages from your radio, under your name.
messages_send.targets_reply: Only replies, in the conversation of the message it is answering.
messages_send.targets_scope: To the channels and contacts it may read.
messages_send.targets_any: To any channel or contact, without being asked. Only allow this for a plugin you trust.
messages_send.quota: At most {{per_hour, number}} messages per hour and {{per_day, number}} per day.

raw_packets_read.title: Read radio packets
raw_packets_read.description: Receives the raw packets the radio hears. It sees what they decrypt to only for the messages it may read.

contacts_read.title: Read contacts
contacts_read.description: Sees the names, public keys, last activity and positions of the nodes you know.

channels_read.title: List channels
channels_read.description: Sees the names and keys of the public channels, and of private ones when it may read every channel. A channel key lets anyone read that channel.

telemetry_read.title: Read telemetry
telemetry_read.description: Receives the telemetry of your nodes and the health of Meshloom.

storage.title: Store data
storage.description: Keeps up to 5 MB of its own data in Meshloom.

http.title: Connect to the internet
http.description: Connects only to the servers listed here, through Meshloom: {{hosts}}.
http.description_lan_only: Connects only to the devices of your local network listed here, through Meshloom.
http.lan_host: This plugin will be able to talk to this device on your network: {{host}}
http.lan_note: Devices on your network are reached directly, possibly without encryption (plain HTTP).
http.private_messages_warning: This plugin can send your private messages to {{hosts}}.

timer.title: Run on a schedule
timer.description: Wakes itself up later, no sooner than 10 seconds after asking.

capabilityErrors.permission_denied: The plugin asked for something it is not allowed to do.
capabilityErrors.quota_exceeded: The plugin reached one of its limits.
capabilityErrors.target_not_allowed: The plugin tried to send a message somewhere it may not send.
capabilityErrors.target_unknown: The plugin tried to send to a channel or contact that does not exist.
capabilityErrors.region_unknown: The plugin asked for a region Meshloom does not know.
capabilityErrors.message_too_long: The plugin's message was too long for the radio.
capabilityErrors.send_failed: The radio did not send the plugin's message.
capabilityErrors.quota_unavailable: Meshloom could not check the sending limits, so the plugin's message was not sent.
capabilityErrors.invalid_params: The plugin made an invalid request.
